item.title: PHP security updates fix 18 flaws, including critical RCE bugs
item.author: Dissent
item.content:encoded: Lawrence Abrams reports: The PHP dev team released security updates for 18 vulnerabilities, including critical flaws that could allow unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute code on vulnerable servers.
